Unlike a quick poll, TablePeace checks hard requirements before comparing the group outcome. Coffee Hub has three kinds of conflict, the library has one, and the makerspace has two.

Try a what-if below to see how a venue or time change affects the example. The check is deterministic, not a live AI response; individual budgets and schedules stay private.
